verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents native Python and JS/TS SDKs for capturing traces. The same SDKs are used to query the API, run experiments (e.g. `run_experiment` in the Python SDK), submit scores, and fetch prompts with client-side caching, so builders can work against first-party SDKs across its core features. Missing for 10: SDKs only evidenced for Python and JS/TS, no in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, and no independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
